Choosing I*Rb to cancel the Veb slope and k≈0.77 places a zero-TC 1.25V bandgap at 0.95V. Total current is 3*0.4uA, about 2.2uW. Long-L devices and a pg-to-vdd capacitor give good line regulation and PSRR. A start-up path through a 200MΩ pull-up costs about 9nA."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (0.4e-6, 0.2e-6, 0.6e-6),   # core branch current (PTAT)
    "N":      (8, 4, 24),                  # PNP area ratio
    "gmid_p": (12, 8, 15),
    "Lp":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "gmid_n": (18, 12, 22),
    "Ln":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "kptat":  (1.0, 0.8, 1.25),            # TC trim on I*Rb
    "Cpg":    (2e-12, 0.5e-12, 5e-12),     # pg-to-vdd decoupling for PSRR
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I"]; N = int(round(p["N"])); T = 300.15
    vref_t = 0.95; vdd = 1.8
    veb = lambda i: 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 / i)
    dveb = lambda v: (v - 1.17 - 3 * UT) / T          # dVeb/dT

    # PTAT core
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I

    # Output branch: Vref = k*(Veb3 + I*Rb), solved iteratively for Q3 current
    i3 = 0.5 * I
    for _ in range(8):
        v3 = veb(i3)
        Rb = p["kptat"] * (-dveb(v3)) * T / I        # I*Rb cancels Veb3 slope
        i3 = max((vref_t - v3) / Rb, 0.02e-6)
    v3 = veb(i3)
    Rpar = vref_t / (I + v3 / Rb)
    Ra = 1.0 / (1.0 / Rpar - 1.0 / Rb)
    vbg = v3 + I * Rb

    # Devices
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.6)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.4)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # Core: branch A (PMOS diode on pg; NMOS M3 source on Q1 emitter)
    n.dev("M5", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M3", "pg", "ng", "e1", "vss", mn)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=1)
    # Branch B (NMOS diode on ng; R1 + Q2 with N-times area)
    n.dev("M6", "ng", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "ng", "ng", "x", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "x", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=N)
    # Output branch: scaled bandgap
    n.dev("M7", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("Ra", "vref", "vss", Ra)
    n.R("Rb", "vref", "e3", Rb)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    # PSRR: make the PMOS gate track VDD
    n.C("Cpg", "vdd", "pg", p["Cpg"])
    # Start-up: sx is pulled high (~9 nA) while ng is low; Ms1 then pulls pg down and ng up.
    # During normal operation ng is about 1.1 V, so Ms3 holds sx low and Ms1 stays off.
    n.R("Rsu", "vdd", "sx", 200e6)
    n.M("Ms3", "sx", "ng", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 1.0)
    n.M("Ms1", "pg", "sx", "ng", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 0.5)

    # Predictions
    i_tot = 3 * I + vdd / 200e6
    power = vdd * i_tot
    # Residual TC is mostly Veb curvature (~2-3 mV over 165 C), plus extra from the non-PTAT Q3 current
    dv_curv = 0.004 * vref_t / vbg + abs(1 - p["kptat"]) * 0.588 * 165 / T * vref_t / vbg
    tc_ppm = dv_curv / (vref_t * 165) * 1e6
    # Line regulation: finite mirror rout; mismatch dI/I ~ dVds*gds/Id
    gds_rel = mp.gds / I
    line_reg = vref_t * gds_rel * 0.5
    psrr_1k = 20 * math.log10(1.0 / max(line_reg / vref_t * vref_t, 1e-4))
    return n, {
        "vref": vref_t,
        "tc_ppm": tc_ppm,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "power": power,
        "psrr_1k": psrr_1k,
        "startup_ok": 1,
        "R1": R1, "Ra": Ra, "Rb": Rb, "vbg": vbg,
    }
```
